svg.title: Mixing time: baffled six-blade turbine
svg.text: Re = 5.04×10⁵ (beyond the printed chart, flat region)
Reynolds number, Re = n Dₐ² ρ / μ
dashed lines: unbaffled tanks; solid line: baffled tank
Mark Re = 5.04×10⁵: beyond the printed range (10⁵), where the baffled-turbine line is flat.
Go up to the solid “turbine, baffled” line, extended flat (dotted) past Re ≈ 2×10³.
Go across to the n·tₜ axis.
(digitized); in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
